headline: Ring confirms its camera drone won’t have manual controls after crashing on CBS News
summary: Ring's security camera drone will operate autonomously with an 'AI Pilot'. It lacks manual control options for users. An embarrassing CBS demo highlighted its limitations.

headline: Nvidia is reportedly preparing to fire Jensen Huang
summary: Nvidia's board is reportedly preparing to dismiss CEO Jensen Huang. This follows a second alleged extramarital affair reported by The New York Times. Huang recently admitted to a separate affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

headline: Hands on with Home Assistant’s new ‘smart home multi-tool’
summary: Home Assistant's new Connect Aux-2 is a multi-function device. It aims to integrate more non-smart devices into smart homes. This tool is part of Home Assistant's efforts for user-friendliness.

headline: United won’t let your AI agent book your flight
summary: United Airlines will not allow AI assistants to book flights. The airline cites privacy and regulatory concerns for this policy. Other businesses also report low AI agent usage for bookings.

headline: Elon Musk Extends Cybertruck Production to 'Work Through' Order Backlog, Says There Must Be Room for 'Sentimentality'
summary: Elon Musk has extended Cybertruck production. This move aims to address the existing order backlog. Musk also stated there must be room for 'sentimentality'.

headline: Newegg Has Slashed $32 off a Nintendo eShop $200 Gift Card, but Not for Long
summary: Newegg is offering a limited-time deal on a Nintendo eShop $200 Gift Card. Get $32 off, bringing the price down to $168. A promo code is required for this discount.

headline: Constantine Director 'Hopeful' for Sequel After DC Studios Shakeup
summary: Constantine director Francis Lawrence is hopeful for a sequel. This optimism follows changes at DC Studios. Fans have long awaited an update on the movie's continuation.

headline: Monster Hunter Outlanders Review
summary: Monster Hunter Outlanders is a new mobile spin-off. It retains core gameplay and visuals from console versions. Progress gates push microtransactions, affecting the experience.

headline: Some under-25s should get fewer benefits, Milburn review to say
summary: A Milburn review proposes a radical overhaul of the welfare system. It suggests moving under-25s off main sickness benefits. This would significantly change youth welfare provisions.

headline: UK economy grows at fastest rate for more than two years, boosted by AI investment
summary: The UK economy grew by 0.7% in the three months to September. This marks the fastest growth rate in over two years. AI investment is cited as a significant contributing factor.

headline: Two men found guilty of spying for Iran over plan to target UK-based journalists
summary: Mostafa Sepahvand and Farhad Javadi Manesh were found guilty. They engaged in conduct assisting Iranian intelligence. The plan involved targeting UK-based journalists.

headline: Activist Daniel Thomas admits criminal damage after slashing migrant dinghy in Channel
summary: Activist Daniel Thomas pleaded guilty to criminal damage. He admitted to slashing a migrant dinghy in the Channel. The case was heard at Portsmouth Crown Court.
